# Shared domain contract development candidate

`openpcb-contracts-1.0.0-candidate.0-pending-publication.tgz` is a clean,
reproducible npm-pack development candidate. Its SHA-256 is
`22a03f6b47b5b3244244102984972d79027e28ffbd8dc39364f9b91ada0d8312`.

The package contains PCB/domain contracts without an assistant export or an
